label: Looking up the derate by depth
section: Looking up the derate by depth
subgoals: Count the logic depth of the path
Read the derate at that depth from the table
Multiply the path delay by the derate

label: Interpolating between depths
subgoals: Find the two depth points that bracket the path depth
Interpolate the derate linearly between them
Multiply the path delay by the interpolated derate

label: Depth and distance together
subgoals: Locate the depth and distance window around the path
Compute the fractional positions along each axis
